def solution():
    # Define variables name and value
    roe_values = [0.12, 0.131, 0.1055, 0.112, 0.1205]
    total_assets = 2100  # millions
    total_liabilities = 1200  # millions
    preferred_equity = 120  # millions
    common_shares_outstanding = 32  # millions

    # Do math calculation to get the answer
    average_roe = sum(roe_values) / len(roe_values)
    common_equity = total_assets - total_liabilities - preferred_equity
    normalized_net_income = average_roe * common_equity
    normalized_eps = normalized_net_income / common_shares_outstanding

    # return answer
    return round(normalized_eps, 3)
